items.reason: Niacinamide is a gentle first active that suits skin that looks a little shiny and works well in the morning.
A gentle cleanser keeps the routine simple without stripping skin that is already moderately hydrated.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports the look of skin comfort and moisture, which scanned in the middle range.
A mineral SPF 50 is needed every morning, especially if you add a retinol at night.
A low-strength 0.3% retinol is a gentle second active for smoother-looking skin over time.

response.routine_note: Morning: cleanser, niacinamide, moisturizer, then SPF. At night: cleanser, retinol on only 2 nights a week at first (moisturizer after), and build up slowly as your skin gets used to it.
